          function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
            var d = new Date();
            d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
            var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
          }
          function getCookie(cname) {
            var name = cname + "=";
            var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
            for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
              var c = ca[i];
              while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
              }
              if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
              }
            }
            return "";
          }

            var name = cname + "=";

            for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
              var c = ca[i];
              while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {

          function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
            var d = new Date();
            d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
            var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
          }
          function getCookie(cname) {
            var name = cname + "=";
            var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
            for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
              var c = ca[i];
              while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
              }
              if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
              }
            }
            return "";
          }

          function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
            var d = new Date();
            d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays*24*60*60*1000));
            var expires = "expires="+ d.toUTCString();
            document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
          }
          function getCookie(cname) {
            var name = cname + "=";
            var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
            var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
            for(var i = 0; i <ca.length; i++) {
              var c = ca[i];
              while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
              }
              if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
              }
            }
            return "";
          }
